title: Volley Spawn Admission Summary
description: Retained load-aware spawn admission verdict, published by a supervisor to volley/_system/admission after every pressure sample. See spec section 4.6.7.

allow.description: How many more agents pressure allows to start now; null means pressure sets no limit (the hard ceiling and spawn budget still apply).

reasons.description: Why starts are throttled, one human-readable line per signal (e.g. 'memory pressure critical (level 4 > max 2)'). Empty when not throttled.

waves.description: Per-wave verdicts (a wave's config: overrides and its repo's CI queue apply), keyed by wave id.

ceiling.description: What the hard ceiling counts: the agents the supervisor runs or is starting in every wave (supervised, launched and being verified, spawning, and one slot per admitted task of a running wave with no agent live that is queued for its first agent or between pipeline roles). See spec section 4.6.4.

launching.description: The part of live not supervised yet: agents starting, and slots held for a task's next agent.

state.description: over: past its threshold now; recovering: tripped earlier and clear (or unmeasurable) for fewer than hysteresis_samples consecutive samples; unknown: could not be measured and not tripped (never throttles).

max.description: The configured threshold the value is compared with.

error.description: Why the last sample could not be measured (state unknown, or recovering on an unmeasurable sample).
